sv.title: Stoppet i Forsmark 3 kan ge ”dubbel effekt” på elpriset
sv.summary: Kärnkraftsreaktorn Forsmark 3 har stoppats helt. Nu kan redan höga elpriser stiga ytterligare i nästa vecka. – Stoppet får stora konsekvenser för elpriset i södra Sverige framför allt, säger elmarknadsanalytikern Christian Holtz.

en.title: Shutdown at Forsmark 3 may have "double effect" on electricity prices
en.summary: The Forsmark 3 nuclear reactor has been fully shut down. Already high electricity prices could now rise further next week. "The shutdown will have major consequences for electricity prices, mainly in southern Sweden," says electricity market analyst Christian Holtz.
